title: Named types: @User defined once, used three times
description: @User<…> names a header; lead:@User and members:[@User] reuse it. Hand-written AK-DATA (the encoder writes inline headers).
question: How many people are in the team, including the lead? Give the team name too.

comments: Team directory: one type, used three times
